75189-buttrick-s-voyages-1812-1819-evans.creator: Unknown
75189-buttrick-s-voyages-1812-1819-evans.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. In preparing this little work for the press, the Editor had not only in view the interest with which an enlightened people seize upon facts not previously in their possession; but sympathy for this unfortunate traveller, who by misfortune has now not only become bereft of his property, but, by providential circumstances, of his sight, contributed to induce him to copy it for the press.

arxiv-2003-10614.title: Sub-exponential Rate of Convergence to Equilibrium for Processes on the Half-Line
arxiv-2003-10614.creator: Andrey Sarantsev
arxiv-2003-10614.description: Abstract . A powerful tool for studying long-term convergence of a Markov process to its stationary distribution is a Lyapunov function. In some sense, this is a substitute for eigenfunctions. For a stochastically ordered Markov process on the half-line, Lyapunov functions can be used to easily find explicit rates of convergence. Our earlier research focused on exponential rate of convergence.

arxiv-2004-10473.title: Where is the context? – A critique of recent dialogue datasets
arxiv-2004-10473.creator: Johannes E. M. Mosig, Vladimir Vlasov, Alan Nichol
arxiv-2004-10473.description: Abstract Recent dialogue datasets like MultiWOZ 2.1 and Taskmaster-1 constitute some of the most challenging tasks for present-day dialogue models and, therefore, are widely used for system evaluation. We identify several issues with the above-mentioned datasets, such as history independence, strong knowledge base dependence, and ambiguous system responses.

arxiv-2102-10816.title: Enhancing gravitational-wave burst detection confidence in expanded detector networks with the BayesWave pipeline
arxiv-2102-10816.creator: Yi Shuen C. Lee, Margaret Millhouse, Andrew Melatos
arxiv-2102-10816.description: Abstract The global gravitational-wave detector network achieves higher detection rates, better parameter estimates, and more accurate sky localisation, as the number of detectors, ℐ \mathcal{I} increases. This paper quantifies network performance as a function of ℐ \mathcal{I} for BayesWave , a source-agnostic, wavelet-based, Bayesian algorithm which distinguishes between true astrophysical signals and instrumental glitches.

arxiv-2107-09907.title: A closed formula of Littlewood-Richardson coefficients
arxiv-2107-09907.creator: Xueqing Wen
arxiv-2107-09907.description: Abstract . We relate the space of GL r \operatorname{GL}_{r} -invariant subspace of tensor product of GL r \operatorname{GL}_{r} representations with the space of parabolic theta functions. And then give a closed formula of Littlewood-Richardson coefficients using Verlinde formula. 1. Introduction We work over the complex number field \mathbb{C} .

arxiv-2108-01706.title: Energy spectrum and structure of one-dimensional few-electron Wigner crystals with and without coupling to light in cavity
arxiv-2108-01706.creator: Chenhang Huang, Daniel Pitagora, Timothy Zaklama, Kálmán Varga
arxiv-2108-01706.description: Abstract Explicitly Correlated Gaussian basis is used to calculate the energies and wave functions of one dimensional few-electron systems in confinement potentials created by external potentials or coupling to light in cavity. The appearance and properties of Wigner crystal-like structures are discussed.

arxiv-2204-03606.title: Thermal Equilibrium Solutions of Black Hole Accretion Flows: Outflows VS Advection
arxiv-2204-03606.creator: Wen-Biao Wu, Wei-Min Gu, Mouyuan Sun
arxiv-2204-03606.description: Abstract Observations and numerical simulations have shown that outflows generally exist in the accretion process. We revisit the thermal equilibrium solutions of black hole accretion flows by including the role of outflows. Our study focuses on the comparison of the cooling rate of outflows with that of advection.

arxiv-2207-14058.title: The decay η ′ → π ​ ρ \eta^{\prime}\to\pi\rho in the chiral NJL model
arxiv-2207-14058.creator: M. K. Volkov 1, A. A. Pivovarov 1, K. Nurlan 1,2,3
arxiv-2207-14058.description: Abstract The branching fraction of the decay η ′ → π ​ ρ \eta^{\prime}\to\pi\rho is calculated in the chiral quark NJL model. The decay exists due to the mass difference between u u - and d d -quarks leading to π 0 − η ′ \pi^{0}-\eta^{{}^{\prime}} mixing.

arxiv-2406-11951.title: Excitonic topology and quantum geometry in organic semiconductors
arxiv-2406-11951.creator: Wojciech J. Jankowski, Joshua J.P. Thompson, Bartomeu Monserrat, Robert-Jan Slager
arxiv-2406-11951.description: Abstract Abstract Excitons drive the optoelectronic properties of organic semiconductors which underpin devices including solar cells and light-emitting diodes. Here we show that excitons can exhibit topologically non-trivial states protected by inversion symmetry and identify a family of organic semiconductors realising the predicted excitonic topological phases.

arxiv-2409-15031.title: Compressive radio-interferometric sensing with random beamforming as rank-one signal covariance projections PubID: pubid: 978-1-6654-4442-2/21 /$31.00 © 2021 IEEE
arxiv-2409-15031.creator: Olivier Leblanc, Yves Wiaux, Laurent Jacques
arxiv-2409-15031.description: Abstract Radio-interferometry (RI) observes the sky at unprecedented angular resolutions, enabling the study of several far-away galactic objects such as galaxies and black holes. In RI, an array of antennas probes cosmic signals coming from the observed region of the sky.

arxiv-2410-22329.title: The Chow and augmented Chow polynomials of Uniform Matroids
arxiv-2410-22329.creator: Elena Hoster
arxiv-2410-22329.description: Abstract . We provide explicit combinatorial formulas for the Chow polynomial and for the augmented Chow polynomial of uniform matroids, thereby proving a conjecture by Ferroni. These formulas refine existing formulas by \Citeauthor Hampe_2017 and by \Citeauthor eur2023stellahedralgeometrymatroids, offering a combinatorial interpretation of the coefficients based on Schubert matroids.

arxiv-2411-19807.title: The Rayleigh-Taylor instability in a binary quantum fluid
arxiv-2411-19807.creator: Y. Geng, J. Tao, M. Zhao, S. Mukherjee, S. Eckel, G. K. Campbell, I. B. Spielman
arxiv-2411-19807.description: Abstract Instabilities, where initially small fluctuations seed the formation of large-scale structures, govern dynamics in a wide variety of fluid systems. The Rayleigh-Taylor instability (RTI) [ 1 , 2 ] is an iconic example and leads to the development of mushroom-shaped incursions when immiscible fluids are forced into each other.

arxiv-2511-12032.title: Improved Masked Image Generation with Knowledge-Augmented Token Representations
arxiv-2511-12032.creator: Guotao Liang, Baoquan Zhang, Zhiyuan Wen, Zihao Han, Yunming Ye
arxiv-2511-12032.description: Abstract Masked image generation (MIG) has demonstrated remarkable efficiency and high-fidelity images by enabling parallel token prediction. Existing methods typically rely solely on the model itself to learn semantic dependencies among visual token sequences. However, directly learning such semantic dependencies from data is challenging because the individual tokens lack clear semantic meanings, and these sequences are usually long.

arxiv-2602-05516.title: Virtual-Tube-Based Cooperative Transport Control for Multi-UAV Systems in Constrained Environments
arxiv-2602-05516.creator: Runxiao Liu, Pengda Mao, Xiangli Le, Shuang Gu, Yapeng Chen, and Quan Quan Senior Member,IEEE
arxiv-2602-05516.description: Abstract This paper proposes a novel control framework for cooperative transportation of cable-suspended loads by multiple unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) operating in constrained environments. Leveraging virtual tube theory and principles from dissipative systems theory, the framework facilitates efficient multi-UAV collaboration for navigating obstacle-rich areas. The proposed framework offers several key advantages.

pmc-11505903.title: The Impact of Neoadjuvant versus Adjuvant Chemotherapy on Survival Outcomes in Locally Advanced Breast Cancer
pmc-11505903.creator: Farhad Ghasemi, Muriel Brackstone
pmc-11505903.description: The utility of neoadjuvant chemotherapy is expanding in the treatment of breast cancer. Although individual trials have shown comparable survival between patients receiving neoadjuvant and adjuvant chemotherapy, large-scale data analyses for outcomes in patients with locally advanced breast cancer (LABC) are lacking.

pmc-12609628.title: A Combination of Lacticaseibacillus paracasei CECT 30660 and Bifidobacterium longum subsp. infantis CECT 7210 Cell-Free Supernatants Reduces LPS-Induced Preterm Birth and Systemic Inflammation in Pregnant Mice

Preterm birth (PTB), affecting approximately 11.1% of pregnancies globally, often results from inflammation at the maternal–fetal interface triggered by microbial or immune dysregulation. This study investigates the efficacy of cell-free supernatant derived from Bifidobacterium longum subsp. infantis CECT 7210 and Lacticaseibacillus paracasei CECT 30660 in mitigating inflammation-induced PTB in a murine model. pmc-12766471.title: Copper-Induced Cell Death in Renal Diseases: Molecular Mechanisms and Therapeutic Implications
pmc-12766471.creator: Daoyuan Lv, Yafen Yu
pmc-12766471.description: Copper dyshomeostasis and the resulting induction of cuproptosis, a novel regulated cell death pathway driven by mitochondrial copper overload, play a critical role in renal pathophysiology. Cuproptosis is characterized by FDX1-mediated copper reduction, irreversible aggregation of lipoylated TCA cycle enzymes, such as dihydrolipoamide S-acetyltransferase, and destabilization of iron‒sulfur cluster proteins, leading to proteotoxic mitochondrial collapse.

pmc-13317940.title: Subfamily-level comparative transcriptomics of key immune regulators in plants and suspension cells reveals novel rice blast resistance genes
pmc-13317940.creator: Wanqing Wang, Fumi Fukada, Tomoyuki Furuta, Alfino Sebastian, Kiwamu Hyodo, Natsuko Ono, Hideki Nishimura, Pingyu Wang, Yoji Kawano
pmc-13317940.description: Plants activate pattern-triggered immunity through key immune components, including pattern recognition receptors (PRRs), receptor-like cytoplasmic kinases (RLCKs), and transcription factors (TFs), to combat pathogens. However, a comprehensive transcriptional overview of these immune regulators at the subfamily level during biotic stress in rice is currently lacking.

pmc-13415561.title: The impact of different decibels of ambient noise on attention
pmc-13415561.creator: Fangfang Liu, Fang Liu, Wen Wen, Yuhang Li, Yulin Duan, Shuang Wei, Peiyao Liu, Min Huang, Fan Xu
pmc-13415561.description: Ambient noise is often perceived as a distractor; however, some individuals may benefit from certain levels of ambient noise to enhance cognitive performance. Despite this, the optimal range of ambient noise for improving attention remains unclear. To disclose this relationship, thirty-eight healthy college students were recruited to perform a 6 ⋅ 6 Schulte grid test under varying ambient noise levels.

Current three-dimensional visualization of these complex vascular structures relies on manual or semi-automated CT segmentation, which is time-consuming and operator-dependent.
